verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is a cloud compute service that handles customer code and data, so a no-training policy or training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack covers sandbox isolation, networking controls, and logging, but nothing documents a policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Isolation features are adjacent and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
